name: MNEE USD
oneLiner: MNEE is a USD stablecoin backed by short-dated U.S. Treasuries and cash at qualified custodians, attested by Wolf and Company under Antigua FSRC license.
collateral: U.S. Treasury bills (≤90-day duration) and USD cash held by a qualified custodian under the issuer's Antigua & Barbuda FSRC license
pegMechanism: Fiat-backed 1:1 with USD; tokens minted upon deposit of USD and burned upon redemption; reserves held at a qualified custodian

jurisdiction.license: Class A Digital Asset Business License

applicabilityBasis.summary: MNEE is a USD-backed stablecoin issued by MNEE Limited with contractual mint and redemption rights for verified customers.

genius.notes: Antigua FSRC licensing and reserve attestations do not establish a U.S. GENIUS permitted-issuer approval or foreign-issuer exception for MNEE.

sourcesChecked: OCC GENIUS Act rulemaking bulletin and public releases
Antigua and Barbuda FSRC digital asset license context
Public foreign payment stablecoin issuer exception materials
negativeEvidenceReview.summary: FSRC licensing and MNEE reserve disclosures were found, but no token-specific public U.S. GENIUS approval, official application, or foreign-issuer registration source was located for MNEE.

blacklistabilityReview.sourceFreeRationale: Resolved from Pharos stablecoin metadata by the blacklistability resolver; no separate manual override source is attached.
blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Inferred review retained: MNEE resolves to Yes because existing metadata classifies the asset as centralized and no manual override narrows that status.

mintAuthority.summary: MNEE minting is controlled by a validator-style minter set: mint operations require three valid minter signatures and the caller must itself be a minter; the proxy has a separate upgrade/admin path.

controls.label: MNEE minter validator set
controls.evidence: Implementation source has roleHolders = 4 and requiredSignatures = 3; mintBurnPauseUnpause mints only when signers are current minters and msg.sender is a minter.
